violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Spray bottled labeled chlorine sanitizer was tested at 0ppm. Stacy uses single-use paper towels.

Handwashing lavatories. — --At first, the trailer was out of water leaving it impossible to wash hands and utensils. Stacy went back home and filled her water tank. All facilities work as they should.
